Snacks

Baked semolina custard

Sült tejbegríz

8 months+ Replaced 40 min 4 portions

Serve warm or cool, with soft cooked fruit on the side. There is no pastry lid.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 400 ml Full-fat milk (Pasteurized)
  • 2 Eggs (Beaten and baked until set)
  • 20 g Fine semolina (Wheat)
  • 1 Eating apple or pear (Peeled and cooked soft, served on the side)

Allergens

milkegggluten

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 160°C.
  2. Warm the milk, whisk in the semolina, and cook for a minute.
  3. Cool slightly, then beat in the eggs.
  4. Pour into small dishes and bake until just set and no liquid egg remains, about 25 minutes.
  5. Meanwhile cook the peeled fruit in a little water until soft.
  6. Serve the custard with the fruit beside it.

Replaced

The usual custard slice is puff pastry and sugar. Pastry and a sweet set custard are not used.

Bake an unsweetened custard of milk, egg, and a little fine semolina, and serve cooked fruit on the side.
